meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 输入 224x224 的 H&E 组织切片图,输出每个切片在各查询基因上的空间表达值(log1p-CPM);可按 HGNC 基因符号在约 1.9 万蛋白编码基因面板中查询。
howto.when: 当你要在约 20x、224x224 的切片上取 log1p-CPM 空间基因表达,想按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因,或用 histolab 切好片后做整张切片预测时触发。

say.text: 把 source 换成 evo2,再跑同一批切片。
say.note: 改用基因组序列嵌入构建基因投影。

howto.what_en: Feeds 224x224 H&E tiles into DeepSpot-M and returns per-tile spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM, queryable by HGNC symbol across a ~19k protein-coding gene panel.
howto.when_en: Use when you need log1p-CPM spatial expression on 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol, or want whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D expression for this 224x224 tile with DeepSpot-M.
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values aligned to your gene list.

say_en.text: Rerun the same tiles with source set to evo2.
Tile with histolab, predict in batches, build a tiles-by-genes matrix.
say_en.note: Drops into AnnData for spatial analysis.
